The separate exact-distance contract reinforces the exact-versus-ANN distinction. It is not VECTOR_SEARCH's grammar authority; VECTOR_SEARCH's own no-approximation section establishes why option c changes the request.
VECTOR(1536) is a valid default float32 native shape within 1998 dimensions. The supplied nonnull matching vector/column avoids hidden type or width errors; Preview float16 is not involved.

choiceReviews.rationale: Retaining TOP_N preserves latest-index Msg 42274 even after adding WITH APPROXIMATE. TOP_N belongs to earlier-index grammar, not this current format.

Removing TOP_N and adding WITH APPROXIMATE after TOP(5) applies both documented repairs while preserving vector, aliases, cap and distance ordering. It requests approximation, not exactly five rows or a mandatory ANN physical plan.
TOP(5) plus distance ordering without WITH APPROXIMATE is exact kNN after TOP_N removal. It could fit an exact-neighbor request but changes the expressly approximate one.
With both caps removed, distance ordering alone neither limits to five nor requests approximation. This full-distance scan can serve an all-row diagnostic, not the application's bounded request.
